svg.title: Flare SM70 long-context decode
svg.desc: Decode-only at 28.7k tokens of context, one Tesla V100 PCIe 32 GB, release binary d4ffb1fa, 2026-10-23: one agent, cold requests, median 72.4 tok/s (70.0 to 81.2); four agents in the first batch, per agent 40.2, 41.1, 42.7 and 46.1 tok/s (median 41.9, sum 170). Source: BENCHMARKS-SM70.md.
